notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger more than two times.
description:
Activate Super-Skrull's fourth ability by paying {5}{U}, targeting an opponent.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Super-Skrull's ability, targeting the same opponent.
Resolve the first Super-Skrull ability, causing the opponent to draw four cards.
Smothering Tithe triggers four times, causing you to create a Treasure token for each time the opponent cannot pay for the trigger.
Repeat steps 3 and 4 for the other Super-Skrull ability.
Activate six Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{U}.
Repeat.
